profile.headline: Freelance Web Developer
profile.summary:
I’m a web and app developer with 20 years of professional experience. I specialize in full stack web development, and I'm experienced in iOS development, server administration, database design, and more. Recently used tech:

Frontend: Javascript/Typescript, React/Redux, CSS3/SASS
Backend: Rust, Node.js, Golang
Databases: Postgresql, SQLite
Other: git, Xcode/Swift

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Worked with multiple clients on web (frontend and backend) and iOS projects
- Designed, built, deployed, and managed a full web platform and website to support the freelance business and generate revenue
positions.insights: Skills: Web Services · DevOps · Web Design · Web Development · Application Development

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Started Ember to React refactor of the Tracer product.
- Started and configured an internal React component library (Github/npm package) used by Tracer.
- Built Ember and React components and features in collaboration with a Python API backend team.
- Participated in the switch to a Agile/scrum development style.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a React based view for handling ecommerce functions inside an iOS/Android app.
- Refactored and added TypeScript and Redux to the project.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
- Helped develop multiple React/Redux based internal tools for importing and managing Apple Maps data.
- Ported a scheduling/planning tool from an older container application to a new one, requiring project reorganization and authentication changes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Took over development of a website speed testing and performance improvement application called Coach.
- Maintained/improved/implemented the following:
-- Architecture based on docker images and server/worker node projects that communicate over Redis      -- Simple Message Queue
-- Bootstrap 4 based design
-- HAR file analysis using tools like PerfCascade
-- Simple team based authentication for maintaining and comparing test runs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed major product features using Node.js, restify, Postgresql, and Angular.
- Setup, updated, and modified continuous integration configurations (Travis CI) for multiple web/API projects.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed internal Angular.js based web app for managing users and devices.
- Investigated issues and contributed bug fixes in the Java based API.
- Explored the advantages/disadvantages of migrating the web app to Angular 2.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Worked on developer.comcast.net using Node.js, MySQL, and Backbone.js using Agile methodologies.
- Worked on deployment strategies for the website and made improvements to the Jenkins build jobs.
- Implemented feature flag system for the website to help manage continuous deployment.
- Worked on the XFINITY APIs and made improvements to the OAuth implementation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on angieslist.com using Python and ASP.NET (C#).
- Learned Scala and worked on utilities and a web application using the Play framework.
- Learned iOS development (Cocoa) and helped develop the SnapFix iOS application.
- Created presentations on Angular.js and iOS development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked with a small team using Agile (scrum) methodology.
- Worked on customizations to the core ASP.NET web project. (VB.NET)
- Modified, created, and maintained Microsoft SQL Server stored procedures.
- Deployed .aspx, .dll, and scripts to client environments.
- Helped define procedures for modifying and organizing projects and deploying code to client environments.
- Helped design web applications using Angular on the front end and APIs using ServerStack on the back end.

positions.title: Application Support Analyst
positions.description: Wrote MSSQL scripts, Crystal Reports, and .NET applications to retrieve and present data to various departments.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Developed and deployed multiple internet applications using ASP.NET (C#), Microsoft SQL Server, and custom SharePoint integration tools.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Developed vacation tracking, time tracking, and performance evaluation web based programs in ASP.NET.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description: Supported customers with issues related to web hosting, web development, and database administration.

positions.title: System Software Specialist
positions.description: Developed printer drivers, utilities and applications for Windows, Mac OS X and Linux.

projects.title: Dwayne.xyz
projects.description:
- Started up Ubuntu server and PostgreSQL instance hosted at DigitalOcean.
- Installed Go, nginx, gitea code repository, web analytics, IRC server, and other software.
- Developed Go web service and design (HTML/CSS/Javascript) for the website.
- Created a stable deployment process with versioning and rollback capability.
- Configured web server, services, DNS settings, and TSL certificates (LetsEncrypt).
